points.quote: **`browser/`** (130 files): the shell, layout, parts and core actions. **`common/`** (34 files): shared contracts and models. **`electron-browser/`** (10 files): the desktop entry layer.
**`api/`** (355 files): bridges between the extension host and the main thread, plus the VS Code API implementation.
It has about 4,600 files, and most of them are in `contrib/`.
